Its shard 1/6 re-measured the same three packages against the same prediction: `OK -- Test Core (1/6), 54.9s measured vs 44.0s predicted across 3 package(s) = 1.25x`. The 24.5s drop between the two runs is close to `trigger-api`'s +22.6s overshoot. An OK verdict prints no per-package split, so this is inferred, not read.
- **Reading:** a one-run outlier in `@objectstack/trigger-api`'s test window on one runner. No commit in the range turns the full battery red, and the dataset (`scripts/test-shard-timings.json`) is not stale on this evidence, because the same packages read 1.25x one hour later.
